surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the adsorption of Pr[N(SiMe3)2]3 and subsequent reaction with water (H2O) to form PrOx films. The reaction is self-limiting and involves the elimination of (Me3Si)2NH as a stable species through surface exchange reactions between the precursor and hydroxyl groups.
evidence: The text states: 'the [N(SiMe3)2] group would be cleanly eliminated as the stable (Me3Si)2NH species via the reaction between Ln[N(SiMe3)2]3 and [OH].'
